meta.name: agent-system-learning-loop
meta.description: Evaluate and improve AgentSystem learning quality for memory/self-compound jobs. Use when bots forget, write filler summaries, fail to update learnings, or memory quality regresses over time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动评估并改进Agent系统的记忆与学习质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Agent系统经常遗忘信息或生成无用的摘要。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically evaluate and improve memory and learning quality of agent systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent system often forgets information or generates useless summaries.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审计学习任务是否产出可用的记忆，检测并标记“让我查一下”等填充内容，检查学习文件是否更新，并给出质量评分。
howto.when: 当机器人遗忘、写填充摘要、未能更新学习内容或记忆质量随时间下降时触发。

say.text: 审计最近72小时的学习质量。
say.note: 运行学习质量审计脚本。

say.text: 检查学习任务运行记录。
say.note: 查看指定任务的最近5次运行。

say.text: 验证学习文件是否更新。
say.note: 列出学习文件和记忆目录的最新内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will audit whether learning jobs produce actionable memory, flag filler summaries like "let me check", verify file updates, and score quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when bots forget, write filler summaries, fail to update learnings, or memory quality regresses over time.

say_en.text: Audit learning quality for the last 72 hours.
say_en.note: Runs the learning quality audit script.
Shows last 5 runs of a specific job.
Lists latest files in learnings.md and memory.
